currency.label: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency with symbol and decimal precision

saved_query.label: Saved Query
saved_query.description: A reusable, composable query — can reference other queries via $ref

platform.label: Platform
platform.description: Social media platform — handle rules derived via HandleFormat typeclass

country.label: Country
country.description: ISO 3166-1 country with dial code, currency, and language

query_category.label: Query Category
query_category.description: Hierarchical category that groups saved queries — categories own query refs

page.label: Page
page.description: A hosted public page — routable, publishable, composed of typed blocks

profile_handle.label: Profile Handle
profile_handle.description: A social-media handle attached to a profile

profile_phone.label: Profile Phone
profile_phone.description: A phone number attached to a profile

profile_tag.label: Profile Tag
profile_tag.description: A manual classification tag on a profile (with optional validity window)

profile_intent.label: Profile Intent
profile_intent.description: A sales intent — what to sell to a profile

profile_relationship.label: Profile Relationship
profile_relationship.description: A connection between two profiles (friend, partner, owner, …)

entitlement.label: Entitlement
entitlement.description: A profile's grant to an item — with optional expiry and grace period

payment_step.label: Payment Step
payment_step.description: A single payment step within a purchase (Stripe / crypto / etc.)

reservation.label: Reservation
reservation.description: A capacity hold on an inventory by a profile, optionally tied to an entitlement

portfolio.label: Portfolio
portfolio.description: A nested group of profiles for manual classification

portfolio_member.label: Portfolio Member
portfolio_member.description: A profile's membership in a portfolio

subscription.label: Subscription
subscription.description: A binding from a source (HTTP webhook, event type, cron, signal) to a Fenel function handler

Bot.label: Bot
Bot.description: Bot registration — token, label, webhook details, collector config. Id<Bot> is first-class for collector dispatch.

Conversation.label: Conversation
Conversation.description: In-flight form-fill conversation between a bot and a chat/user. Carries the field schedule, partial value, status cursor, and hooks for completion.

UsAddress.label: US address
UsAddress.description: United States postal address — line1/line2, city, state, ZIP code

CaAddress.label: Canadian address
CaAddress.description: Canadian postal address — line1/line2, city, province, postal code

GbAddress.label: UK address
GbAddress.description: United Kingdom postal address — line1/line2, town/city, postcode (no county field)

DeAddress.label: German address
DeAddress.description: German postal address — line1/line2, Stadt, PLZ (no state field)

FrAddress.label: French address
FrAddress.description: French postal address — line1/line2, Ville, Code postal (no state field)

JpAddress.label: Japanese address
JpAddress.description: Japanese postal address — postal-first ordering, prefecture, city, ward, building

UrlStr.label: URL
UrlStr.description: String constrained to a valid URL (format:url predicate)

EmailStr.label: Email
EmailStr.description: String constrained to a valid email address (format:email)

PhoneStr.label: Phone
PhoneStr.description: String constrained to a valid phone number (format:phone)

PhoneNumber.label: Phone Number
PhoneNumber.description: String constrained to a valid phone number (format:phone)

Importance.label: Importance
Importance.description: Refined Number in [0, 1] — relative weighting for tags

Handle.label: Handle
Handle.description: String constrained to a valid handle (format:handle)

NonNegAmount.label: Non-Negative Amount
NonNegAmount.description: Refined Number ≥ 0 — monetary amount in subunits

SubscriptionSlug.label: Subscription Slug
SubscriptionSlug.description: String constrained to a valid URL segment (format:url-segment)

PurchaseStatus.label: Purchase Status
PurchaseStatus.description: Enum: pending | active | completed | refunded | cancelled

PageSlug.label: Page Slug
PageSlug.description: String matching the kebab-case slug pattern ([a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*)

UsPostalCode.label: ZIP code
UsPostalCode.description: String constrained to a US ZIP code (5 digits, optional +4)

CaPostalCode.label: Postal code
CaPostalCode.description: String constrained to a Canadian postal code (A1A 1A1)

GbPostalCode.label: Postcode
GbPostalCode.description: String constrained to a UK postcode

DePostalCode.label: PLZ
DePostalCode.description: String constrained to a German postal code (5 digits)

FrPostalCode.label: Code postal
FrPostalCode.description: String constrained to a French postal code (5 digits)

JpPostalCode.label: 郵便番号
JpPostalCode.description: String constrained to a Japanese postal code (123-4567)

profile.label: Profile
profile.description: A person, organization, or AI agent

item.label: Item
item.description: A product or service that can be sold

inventory.label: Inventory
inventory.description: A capacity-bounded resource — slug, capacity, reservation enforcement

purchase.label: Purchase
purchase.description: A profile's purchase of a plan — pending, active, completed, refunded, or cancelled

plan.label: Plan
plan.description: An offer — one expression: context in, terms out

function.label: Function
function.description: A FenelFunction — pure callable spec, optionally with triggers (function_triggers) for durable execution and instances (function_instances) for runtime state.

account.label: Account
account.description: Tenant identity — name, slug, and free-form config record

integration.label: Integration
integration.description: External connector — type + credentials + config + enabled flag

entity_definition.label: Entity Definition
entity_definition.description: User-defined entity type — name + schema + default render templates

Maybe.label: Maybe
Maybe.description: Optional value — Nothing | Just a. The canonical encoding of absence in Fenel; no nulls anywhere.

Result.label: Result
Result.description: Tagged union of success/failure — Err e | Ok a. Use for any expression whose evaluation can fail with a typed error.

Either.label: Either
Either.description: Haskell-style biased sum — Left a | Right b. Use for value-level Or-shapes without failure semantics. Draft<T>'s field wrappers are Either<String, T_field>: Left = raw input awaiting reconciliation, Right = parsed-and-validated typed value.

LookupResult.label: Lookup Result
LookupResult.description: Explicit-ambiguity surface for dispatch.lookup — Unique a | Conflict (List a) | None. Callers explicitly handle each arm rather than the registry silently picking. Phase 10a sub-step 1 only populates Unique / None; Conflict becomes load-bearing once 10a-4's typed-Id dispatch makes duplicate registrations structurally detectable.

Module.label: Module
Module.description: A scoped Name → Ref view over the one global registry — Fenel's first-class module value (design/module-system.md). `members : Map String Ref` is the scope; a member whose Ref points at another Module is a submodule (namespace, for free). The next subsumption in the lineage that turned typeclasses into entity types: the TS `FenelModule` bundle becomes a Fenel `Module` value.
